name: hudumika
description: Hudumika — Workspace platform for customs clearance, compliance, finance, and freight operations

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && npm run check:triggers -w apps/api
